ruleDefinitions.name: File Time Attribute Change
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect file time attribute change to hide new or changes to existing files

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/touch$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-t.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-acmr.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-d.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-r.*")))
